title: TimeProofs Proof Bundle v0.2
description: JSON schema for TimeProofs proof bundles (.tproof.json) in version timeproofs-0.2

algorithm.description: Hash algorithm used for the data digest

value.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 digest of the data bytes

issuedAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when the proof was issued

issuer.description: Base URL of the issuing TimeProofs API

nonce.description: Optional nonce to distinguish multiple proofs for the same hash

hmac.description: Base64-encoded HMAC-SHA256 over a canonical payload

signature.description: Base64-encoded Ed25519 signature over a canonical payload

publicKey.description: Base64-encoded Ed25519 public key used to verify the signature

keyId.description: Key identifier, mapped to issuer JWKS (/.well-known/jwks.json)

meta.description: Optional local-only metadata describing the context of the data

mime.description: MIME type of the data (e.g. application/pdf, image/png)

domain.description: Business or process domain (e.g. legal, finance, ml-training)

purpose.description: Why this proof was created (release, audit-log, regulatory-archive, etc.)

createdBy.description: Local identifier of the user, system, or agent that created the bundle

tool.description: Tool name and version that produced the bundle

userSign.description: Optional local-only signature over meta or additional local context

publicKey.description: Base64-encoded public key held by the user or organization

signature.description: Base64-encoded signature over a canonical representation of meta
